text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Copano Rickey soared like a rising dragon, but—

Even that was merely the prologue.
Breaking Japanese dirt records one after another—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey! Another GⅠ victory!!
Her record enters completely uncharted territory!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Truly the ultimate champion! Standing tall upon the dirt,
continuing to carve out an unshakeable Feng Shui legend!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Tarumae!
It's because you were there that I made it this far...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Rickey.
However—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's too early to thank me!
Next time, I'll be the one passing you!
"As the twin pillars of the dirt, their bond was deeper than anyone's, and—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We're full! We're totally full, okay~?!
All tickets for the Feng Shui Consultation have been handed out~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ehh. Ricky-chan, read mine too~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Next time, then! You have to at the next consultation session, okay?!"
By now, every Umamusume had come to seek Copano Rickey's advice.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if we'd known this would happen,
we should've picked a slightly bigger venue.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe capping it at 60 people was too small after all.
Next time, let's bump up the capacity and make it longer.

The popularity of feng shui has firmly taken root.
It has completely transitioned from a passing fad into a true culture.

A thought crosses my mind. Now that she's achieved her two big goals
of "becoming the Dirt King" and "spreading Feng Shui,"
what will Copano Rickey...
"Where are we headed from here?" I wondered.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? My... future goals?
I decided to ask Copano Rickey frankly what was on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"That's obvious, Trainer.
I can see it clearly with my own eyes."
choice_data_list: Did you find yourself a new dream or something?
Did you find a new dream?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't know if it's new or not,
but I can see it clearly.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: My goal. That is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "From here on out, I'll keep using feng shui to make everyone just a little bit happier!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just that. Or rather,
this has always been the same.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Spreading feng shui and becoming the dirt champion
might look like two different things, but their goal is the same.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I just want to make everyone a little bit happier.
That's all I'm thinking about.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
True, throughout the history of Feng Shui,
there were people who sought even more, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For example... a certain noble might use it
to oust their rivals at court—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "There were researchers who tried to use feng shui for their own selfish desires, too. But—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Things like that never last.
Feng shui is about harmonizing a space. It exists to improve the environment for all of us."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Unless you create a place where everyone can be happy in a balanced way, it won't last.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"A little bit happier than yesterday, for everyone."
Don't you think that's enough?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
To prove that, I want to run just a little faster
than yesterday. And I want to keep that up
forever. If I do that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because it makes them believe
that anyone can make their life better.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because they'll understand that taking it one step at a time
is the path to true happiness.

—A dream. It's something you hold up high.
Somewhere inside me, I always felt that way.

Still, Copano Rickey's dream is different.
To be just a tiny bit happier than yesterday.
And for it to be sustainable.

It was the very essence of feng shui. A truly harmonious way
of building a 'natural future' at one with nature.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, why the gloomy look?
Did something happen?
choice_data_list: No, I just thought it was wonderful.
No, I was just thinking how wonderful it is.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Don't praise me out of nowhere like that~! It's nothing special anyway. Don't I always talk about this kind of stuff?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Besides, don't take things too seriously.
If you don't do everything brightly and cheerfully,
you won't be able to keep it up☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Right, right! Then Trainer, lend me a hand with getting the advice booth ready!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
On that day, besides feng shui consultations,
I have something else I want to show everyone☆

And then came the day of the Copano Rickey Feng Shui Consultation.
After the main events had wrapped up—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, after the feng shui consultation,
it's time for the live performance ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Have as much fun as you can, and be even happier starting tomorrow, okay? ♪"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Well then—music, start!
Copano Rickey's song begins to play, and then—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's do what we wanna do♪
Let's do what we can't even do♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The power of feng shui is wonderful~♪
Everyone is waiting for it~♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's bound to get it!
Run with all you've got and they'll understand! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Do Rickey♪ Do Rickey♪
Go go Rickey♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Do Rickey♪ Do Rickey♪
Go go Rickey♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Do Rickey♪ Do Rickey♪
Go go Rickey♪ Fuu~!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickeyâ Luckyâ Super Happy!!
(WOOOAAAHH!!)

"Copano Rickey," possessing tremendous feng shui power
and boundless cheerful energy. Yes, she is—

Always striving for just that little bit of happiness.
With her natural cheer and her steadfast, signature
Rickey-style running.
